description: This test script checks for proper usage patterns in Azure-related Python files, specifically verifying that direct instantiations of AzureOpenAI or AsyncAzureOpenAI are avoided, advocating for the use of get_azure_openai_client. It includes functions to find relevant files in a directory structure and parse their ASTs to detect problematic instantiations.

methods.name: find_azure_files(base_dir)
methods.description: Finds all Python files within a specified base directory and its subdirectories.

methods.name: check_direct_instantiation(file_path)
methods.description: Checks a given Python file to identify direct instantiations of AzureOpenAI or AsyncAzureOpenAI outside of specific allowed classes/methods.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the checks across all Azure Python files in the project and raises an error if any violations are found.
